name: North Korea IRBM Test with Maneuverable Reentry Vehicle
target: East Sea / Sea of Japan splash zone
description: North Korea launched a solid-fuel IRBM fitted with a maneuverable reentry vehicle from the Sunan area near Pyongyang, traveling approximately 1,000 km.

name: Pulhwasal-3-31 Submarine-Launched Cruise Missile Tests
description: North Korea conducted two test launches of the Pulhwasal-3-31 submarine-launched strategic cruise missile from a submarine off Sinpo Naval Base.

name: Freedom Shield 2024 Exercise
description: The US and ROK conducted the annual 11-day Freedom Shield exercise, for the first time rehearsing responses to a hypothetical North Korean nuclear strike.

name: Hwasong-16B Hypersonic IRBM Test
target: East Sea target at 1,000 km range
description: North Korea test-launched the Hwasong-16B, its first solid-fueled IRBM equipped with a hypersonic glide vehicle, reaching peaks of 101.1 km and 72.3 km altitude.

name: Failed Malligyong-1-1 Spy Satellite Launch
description: A new-type rocket carrying the Malligyong-1-1 spy satellite launched from Sohae but exploded shortly after liftoff. North Korea's fourth satellite attempt after one success in November 2023.

name: North Korea Trash Balloon Campaign Begins
target: South Korean territory south of DMZ
description: North Korea launched 260 balloons carrying feces, garbage, and waste batteries across the DMZ. Over the summer, approximately 2,000 trash-filled balloons were sent as retaliation for anti-DPRK leaflets.

name: North Korea GPS Spoofing Campaign
target: South Korean civilian aircraft and maritime vessels
description: North Korea conducted GPS spoofing operations near the border, disrupting navigation for 201 aircraft and 731 ships by feeding false position data to approaching aircraft.

name: South Korea Resumes DMZ Loudspeaker Broadcasts
description: South Korea redeployed loudspeakers along the DMZ for the first time in six years, broadcasting anti-DPRK propaganda and K-pop in response to the trash balloon campaign.

name: Inaugural Freedom Edge Trilateral Exercise
description: The US, ROK, and Japan conducted the first-ever Freedom Edge exercise involving the USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group, creating a new framework for trilateral security cooperation.

name: North Korea Enacts Updated Nuclear Doctrine Law
description: Kim Jong Un declared DPRK's nuclear status 'irreversible,' authorizing preemptive nuclear strikes and mandating automatic launch if leadership command-and-control is threatened.

name: North Korea Demolishes Inter-Korean Roads and Railways
target: Gyeongui and Donghae inter-Korean road and rail links
description: The KPA detonated 60-meter stretches of both inter-Korean roads and rail lines just 10 meters north of the MDL, symbolizing the declaration that North and South are 'two hostile countries at war.'

name: DPRK Troops Deploy to Russian Kursk Front
casualties: ~4,700 DPRK casualties incl. ~600 killed by Apr 2025 (ROK NIS); 7,000+ by Jun 2026 (Ukraine HUR estimate)
description: Approximately 10,000-12,000 North Korean soldiers deployed to Russia's Kursk Oblast to fight against Ukrainian forces. NATO confirmed the deployment on October 28.

name: Hwasong-19 Solid-Fuel ICBM First Test
target: Sea of Japan west of Okushiri Island
description: The Hwasong-19 flew 85.93 minutes to 7,687.5 km altitude — the longest flight for any DPRK ICBM. Likely intended for MIRV capability.

name: South Korea Martial Law Crisis and Presidential Impeachment
description: President Yoon declared martial law at 22:27, but 190 legislators unanimously lifted it by 01:02. Yoon was impeached December 14 and removed April 4, 2025 — the most severe political disruption since democratization.

name: Lazarus Group Bybit $1.5 Billion Cryptocurrency Theft
description: North Korea's Lazarus Group executed the largest cryptocurrency theft in history via a supply chain compromise. DPRK has stolen over $5 billion in crypto since 2017.

name: Freedom Shield 2025 Exercise
description: Annual exercise tested upgraded responses to DPRK nuclear threats including drones, GPS jamming, and cyberattack scenarios amid South Korea's political instability.

name: Choe Hyon 5,000-ton Destroyer Launched at Nampo
target: Korean People's Navy first modern destroyer
description: Kim Jong Un attended the launch of the Choe Hyon, the KPN's first 5,000-ton destroyer, at Nampo shipyard, and oversaw test-firings of its cruise and anti-air missiles days later. Its Russian-pattern sensors and CIWS pointed to Moscow's technical assistance.

name: DPRK 'Nuclear Trigger' Tactical Nuclear Strike Drill
description: Kim Jong Un oversaw a 'joint striking drill' using the national combined nuclear weapons management system, launching KN-25 rockets and at least one SRBM from Wonsan.

name: Second Destroyer Capsizes at Chongjin Launch
description: The KPN's second 5,000-ton destroyer capsized during a side-launch at Chongjin in front of Kim Jong Un, who called it a 'criminal act'. The hull was righted within weeks and relaunched at Rajin in June 2025 as the Kang Kon.

name: Lee Jae-myung Wins Snap Presidential Election
target: ROK presidency after Yoon Suk-yeol's removal
description: Democratic Party candidate Lee Jae-myung won the snap election triggered by the Constitutional Court's April 2025 removal of Yoon Suk-yeol over the December 2024 martial-law decree, taking office the next day. His government halted loudspeaker broadcasts across the DMZ within its first weeks and sought to reopen channels with Pyongyang.

name: Kim Joins Xi and Putin at Beijing Victory Day Parade
description: Kim Jong Un stood alongside Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin at Beijing's parade marking 80 years since the end of WWII — his first multilateral appearance — after travelling by armoured train, and held separate talks with both leaders.

name: Hwasong-20 ICBM Unveiled at WPK 80th Anniversary Parade
description: North Korea unveiled the Hwasong-20, described as its 'strongest nuclear strategic weapon,' on an unprecedented 11-axle TEL. China's Premier Li Qiang and Russia's Medvedev attended.

name: Hwasong-11E Hypersonic SRBM Dual Launch
target: Tableland target in North Hamgyong Province
description: Two hypersonic SRBMs traveled 350 km northeast, striking a tableland target. US Indo-Pacific Command condemned the tests ahead of the APEC summit.

name: Long-Range Strategic Cruise Missile Test
description: North Korea's final weapons test of 2025, capping a year of significant missile development including the Hwasong-20 unveiling, multiple hypersonic tests, and the Nuclear Trigger system debut.

name: DPRK Ballistic Missile Tests Open 2026
target: East Sea / Sea of Japan at 900 km range
description: North Korea launched multiple ballistic missiles from the Pyongyang area, traveling approximately 900 km into the East Sea at altitudes around 50 km. South Korea's JCS and Japan's MOD confirmed the launches. This was the DPRK's first missile test of 2026.

name: Yoon Suk-yeol Sentenced to Life for Insurrection
description: Seoul Central District Court sentenced former President Yoon Suk-yeol to life imprisonment for leading an insurrection during his December 2024 martial law declaration. Prosecutors had sought the death penalty. Former Defense Minister Kim Yong-hyun received 30 years.

name: 9th Workers' Party of Korea Congress
description: The 9th WPK Congress convened February 19-25 at the April 25 House of Culture with 5,000 delegates. Kim Jong Un was re-elected General Secretary and announced simultaneous nuclear and conventional force buildup. A new five-year plan emphasized AI and space technology. Fifty nuclear-capable rocket launchers were displayed at the post-congress parade.

name: Freedom Shield 2026 Exercise
description: The annual Freedom Shield 26 combined exercise ran March 9-19, validating US-ROK combined readiness against threats including cyber warfare, missile defense, and asymmetric tactics. The exercise also assessed the conditions-based transition of wartime operational control.

name: KN-25 10-Missile Barrage During Freedom Shield
target: Island target in Sea of Japan at 360 km range
description: North Korea fired 10 ballistic missiles from KN-25 multiple rocket launchers, striking an island target approximately 360 km away in the Sea of Japan. Two artillery companies and 12 launchers were mobilized. The barrage coincided with the ongoing US-ROK Freedom Shield 26 exercise.

name: Choe Hyon Destroyer Cruise and Anti-Ship Missile Tests
description: The 5,000-ton destroyer Choe Hyon launched two cruise missiles and three anti-ship missiles in its first weapons trials, observed by Kim Jong Un. Cruise missiles flew over two hours and anti-ship missiles over 30 minutes along pre-set trajectories before striking targets in the western seas.

name: Lazarus Group KelpDAO $292M Cryptocurrency Theft
description: North Korea's Lazarus Group TraderTraitor subunit compromised two RPC nodes used by LayerZero's Decentralized Verifier Network, then DDoS'd legitimate nodes to force failover to poisoned ones, enabling a fraudulent cross-chain message draining approximately $292 million. DPRK cumulative crypto theft now exceeds $6 billion since 2017.

name: DPRK Cluster Munition SRBM Test
target: Island target in Sea of Japan
description: North Korea launched five short-range ballistic missiles armed with cluster and fragmentation warheads against an island target in the Sea of Japan, overseen by Kim Jong Un. ROK JCS assessed the missiles flew approximately 140 km.

name: New Lightweight Launch System and Cruise Missile Test
target: Test targets in western sea area
description: North Korea tested a newly developed lightweight multi-purpose missile launching system and a multiple tactical cruise missile weapon system. State media reported Kim Jong Un oversaw the tests, which were aimed at diversifying mobile launch platforms.

name: Destroyer Choe Hyon Enters Service
description: The 5,000-ton Choe Hyon, lead ship of its class and the Korean People's Navy's first destroyer, was formally commissioned. The warship carries 88 VLS cells, anti-ship missiles, a 127/130mm naval gun, a Pantsir-ME CIWS, and torpedo tubes. A sister ship, Kang Kon, is undergoing sea trials after a capsizing accident during its May 2025 launch.

name: HUR Reports 7,000+ DPRK Casualties in Kursk Oblast
target: Intelligence assessment of DPRK troop losses
casualties: 7,000+ DPRK troops killed or wounded (HUR claim, unverified)
description: Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR) reported North Korean forces had suffered over 7,000 casualties in Kursk Oblast since their late 2024 deployment. South Korean and British intelligence separately assessed approximately 6,000 killed or wounded. More than 20,000 DPRK troops have been deployed to Russia in total.

name: Putin Meets DPRK Foreign Minister in Moscow
description: President Putin received DPRK Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui at the Kremlin, continuing high-level diplomatic engagement between Moscow and Pyongyang amid the ongoing military partnership in Ukraine.

name: DPRK Short-Range Ballistic Missile from Wonsan
description: North Korea launched a short-range ballistic missile from the Wonsan area into the Sea of Japan, its first ballistic missile test since April 19. The test came days before the scheduled start of US-ROK Ulchi Freedom Shield exercises.

name: DPRK Missile Launch Ahead of Ulchi Freedom Shield
description: North Korea launched a ballistic missile from the Wonsan area that traveled over 700 km into the East Sea. ROK JCS confirmed the launch at approximately 6:00 AM local time. This was the DPRK's 11th suspected ballistic missile test of 2026, five days before Ulchi Freedom Shield.

name: Ulchi Freedom Shield 2026 Exercise
description: The annual Ulchi Freedom Shield exercise began August 17 with approximately 18,000 ROK troops and personnel from 11 UNC member states. Scheduled to run to August 27, it was cut to five days and ended August 21 after Trump ordered the Pentagon to 'substantially reduce' US involvement, citing Seoul's refusal to help in the Iran war. Scenarios incorporated DPRK combat lessons from Ukraine and addressed drones, GPS disruption, and cyberattacks.

name: Trump Signals Plans for Kim Jong Un Meeting
description: President Trump stated publicly that he expects to meet Kim Jong Un later in 2026, reportedly targeting the November APEC summit. Kim Yo Jong responded that while the personal relationship remains excellent, scaling back exercises has not changed what Pyongyang views as US hostile policy. North Korea set demanding preconditions for any talks.

name: KN-25 Barrage as Ulchi Freedom Shield Concludes
target: East Sea at approximately 300 km range
description: North Korea fired more than 10 short-range ballistic missiles from 600mm KN-25 multiple rocket launchers, traveling approximately 300 km toward the East Sea. The ROK presidential office convened an emergency security meeting. ROK Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back assessed DPRK possesses 80-120 nuclear warheads and noted KN-25 systems are capable of delivering tactical nuclear weapons.

name: Freedom Edge 2026 Trilateral Exercise Off Jeju
description: The fourth Freedom Edge exercise ran September 7-11 in international waters east and south of Jeju, opening at Yokota Air Base, adding air-defense, medevac and maritime-interdiction serials. It went ahead at full scope weeks after Trump ordered Ulchi Freedom Shield cut short. North Korea fired SRBMs the day after it ended.

name: DPRK SRBMs in 'Joint Firepower Attack' Drill From Wonsan
target: East Sea at approximately 250 km range
description: South Korea's JCS detected multiple short-range ballistic missiles fired from the Wonsan area at about 05:20 KST on September 12, flying about 250 km into the East Sea, a day after Freedom Edge ended. KCNA called it a joint firepower attack drill involving attack drones, tactical cruise missiles, a large-caliber thermobaric multiple rocket launcher and tactical ballistic missiles. Date given in UTC (Sept 11, 20:20Z).

name: DPRK Tests 'New-Type Weapon' With Two Ballistic Missiles
description: North Korea fired a ballistic missile from the Wonsan area around 15:00 KST and a second about three hours later; ROK JCS put the ranges at about 450 km and more than 600 km, both falling outside Japan's EEZ. KCNA said Kim Jong Un, with Kim Ju Ae, supervised a test of an 'ultra-modern' new-type weapon system and showed a trajectory display of over 900 km, which Seoul said 'cannot be 100% trusted'. The launch came as Pyongyang denounced an IAEA General Conference resolution.

name: DMZ Mine Blast Wounds Three ROK Soldiers; Mines Ruled North Korean
target: ROK 25th Infantry Division troops clearing a patrol route in the western DMZ
casualties: 3 ROK soldiers wounded (2 seriously, incl. a battalion commander)
description: Two mines exploded about 10 m south of the Military Demarcation Line while 25th Infantry Division soldiers cleared a new search route, wounding three. On October 5 the JCS said a joint probe with UN Command found North Korean troops had crossed the MDL and deliberately buried at least four mines more than a year earlier; two unexploded mines were removed. Pyongyang denies responsibility. Seoul counts about 50 DPRK MDL crossings so far in 2026 versus 17 in 2025. Plotted point is approximate (25th Division sector).

name: Lee Jae-myung UN Address Urges US-DPRK Talks, Phased Denuclearization
description: At the 81st UN General Assembly, President Lee Jae-myung called for long-suspended US-North Korea dialogue to resume 'without delay', leading to a formal end of the Korean War and a peace regime. He proposed a phased approach: freeze, then reduce, then eliminate the North's nuclear and missile capabilities. US, ROK and Japanese foreign ministers met in New York the day before and reaffirmed 'complete denuclearization'.

name: Two North Korean POWs Transferred From Ukraine to South Korea
target: Two DPRK soldiers captured fighting for Russia
description: President Zelensky announced that two North Korean soldiers captured while fighting for Russia, held for over a year, had been transferred to South Korea, an arrival Seoul had kept out of public view. The disclosure sparked a diplomatic feud between Seoul and Kyiv.

name: Russia Formally Invites Kim Jong Un to Visit
description: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko told TASS that Kim Jong Un has been invited to visit Russia, with dates being arranged through diplomatic channels. Kim has never visited Moscow; the invitation follows FM Choe Son Hui's July trip and rests on the 2024 mutual-defense treaty.

name: DPRK Hypersonic Intermediate-Range Missile Launch From Wonsan
target: East Sea, outside Japan's EEZ (700+ km)
description: North Korea fired one ballistic missile northeast from the Wonsan area around 06:30 KST on October 3; ROK JCS said it flew over 700 km and Japan put the apogee near 90 km. KCNA called it an intermediate-range 'hypersonic strategic weapon system' drill hitting a target 1,000 km away, overseen by Kim Jong Un; analysts suggest a Hwasong-16B-class system. Japan protested a UNSC violation.

name: South Korea's First Successful Hypersonic Glide Vehicle Test
description: President Lee Jae-myung watched the Agency for Defense Development's first successful test of a domestically developed hypersonic glide vehicle at the Anheung test facility in Taean. The Blue House called it a significant step toward a new deterrent, weeks after two DPRK launches billed as hypersonic.

name: Kim Opens Weapons Museum as WPK Marks 81st Anniversary
description: North Korea marked the WPK's 81st anniversary on October 10 with a low-key concert and no military parade or speech by Kim. On October 11 Kim opened a 'National Defense Revolution Museum' displaying Hwasong-20 and Hwasong-17 ICBMs, hypersonic IRBMs, SLBMs and drones, vowing weapons development 'in a more strenuous manner'. Its location was not disclosed.

name: Russian Emergencies Minister Kurenkov Visits Pyongyang
description: EMERCOM head Alexander Kurenkov arrived at Pyongyang Sunan airport late on October 11 on his first DPRK visit; the sides reportedly signed a 2027-2029 action plan, and Pyongyang seeks Russian rescue equipment after an agreement for Russia to train North Korean rescuers.

name: EU Sanctions DPRK and Russian Targets Over Weapons Cooperation
target: 3 individuals and 4 entities supporting DPRK weapons programs
description: The EU added three individuals and four entities to its autonomous DPRK sanctions list as part of its largest sanctions package to date (1,569 listings, mostly Russia's military-industrial complex). The listings include a North Korean missile official sent to help Russia fight in Ukraine and Russian firms accused of labor violations.

name: DPRK Fires Two Tactical Ballistic Missiles, One Flies ~910 km
description: North Korea fired at least two ballistic missiles at about 09:19 and 09:36 KST; Japan said the first flew ~220 km (20 km apogee) and the second ~910 km (70 km apogee) on an 'irregular' trajectory, both landing outside its EEZ. KCNA called it a 'tactical ballistic missile' test; the photographed launcher resembles the Hwasong-11C/11E TEL. Launch site was reported as near Pyongyang (Reuters via Wikipedia, not confirmed); plotted point is approximate. It was the fourth DPRK launch in a month.
